modules.title: Project and data
modules.line: Create a project, import a stack, look at dates, baselines and a coherence preview.

steps.name: project
steps.caption: Open or create a project: its folder holds the products, the logs and project.json.

steps.name: stack
steps.caption: Import a stack (GAMMA/StaMPS export, SAFE, BEAM-DIMAP or a crop): dates, geometry and the baseline plot.

steps.name: preview
steps.caption: A quick coherence preview of a pair tells whether it is worth processing.

modules.title: System check
modules.line: Preflight table: Python, GPU, SNAPHU, SNAP, credentials, read-only data roots.

steps.name: preflight
steps.caption: The preflight runs before every job: interpreter, packages, GPU, SNAPHU, SNAP, disk space, project.

steps.name: settings
steps.caption: Credentials are stored in the system keyring and shown as present / missing only; read-only data roots are searched first for orbits, DEM tiles and GACOS grids.

modules.title: DInSAR
modules.line: Choose a pair, set the parameters, run, read the LOS displacement on the map.

steps.name: pair
steps.caption: Run page, DInSAR: pick the stack and the pair. The command box shows the one command the button will run.

steps.name: parameters
steps.caption: Parameters per step; an unset field shows the value that will be chosen ("auto (…)"). Only what differs from the default is written into the command.
steps.command: bosar pipeline dinsar tour/indy_crop --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --pair 20240821_20240914 --looks 2,10 --backend snaphu

steps.name: running
steps.caption: While it runs: steps with their state and duration, the live log, progress in the status bar, Stop cancels cleanly.

steps.name: result
steps.caption: Results page: the LOS displacement (positive toward the satellite) over OpenStreetMap; hover for value, unit and lat/lon.

modules.title: GACOS correction
modules.line: What is missing, the run with --tropo gacos, displacement before and after.

steps.name: aux
steps.caption: Aux page: what the project has - orbits, DEM, GACOS grids - and where each came from.

steps.name: assistant
steps.caption: Before a run the assistant lists only what this run needs, what is automatic and what needs you (the GACOS request).

steps.name: run
steps.caption: Tick the GACOS correction: the tropo_gacos step joins the chain before the displacement.
steps.command: bosar pipeline dinsar tour/indy_crop --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --pair 20240821_20240914 --tropo gacos --tag gacos

steps.name: before_after
steps.caption: Left without, right with the GACOS correction, the two views linked.

modules.title: Coherence change detection
modules.line: Pre- and co-event pairs, the run, the damage proxy map over satellite imagery.

steps.name: pairs
steps.caption: Coherence change: tick the pre-event pairs and the co-event pair; the planned steps list what will run and what is reused.

steps.name: z_map
steps.caption: The coherence-change z map over the Sentinel-2 cloudless mosaic, 75 % opaque.

steps.name: dpm
steps.caption: The damage proxy map: connected groups above the threshold. Here the "event" is one year of urban change.

modules.title: Amplitude change
modules.line: Log-ratio and pre/post RGB composite over the basemap.

steps.name: dates
steps.caption: Amplitude change: a pre- and a post-event date; the stack is normalised to its temporal median first.

steps.name: log_ratio
steps.caption: Log ratio in dB over the basemap: red brighter, blue darker than before.

steps.name: rgb
steps.caption: Pre/post RGB composite (R = before, G and B = after): new bright targets are cyan, vanished ones red.

modules.title: Result viewer
modules.line: Basemaps, layer opacity and masks, stretch, linked views, figure export, two chains compared.

steps.name: layers
steps.caption: The Layers panel: basemap, and per layer visibility, opacity 0-100 %, order and an optional coherence mask.

steps.name: satellite_mask
steps.caption: Sentinel-2 cloudless basemap, the displacement at 50 % and hidden where the coherence is below 0.4.

steps.name: overlay
steps.caption: Any geocoded product can be laid over the map as a further layer and moved up or down.

steps.name: stretch_linked
steps.caption: Stretch per view (percentile, min-max, manual, gamma), remembered per product kind; the two views pan and zoom together.

steps.name: figure
steps.caption: "Export view" writes a PNG or PDF at the chosen DPI with legend, scale bar, north arrow and attribution; the CLI commands of the layers are in the file's metadata.

steps.name: compare
steps.caption: Compare two chains: classic PSI points against the PS / DS velocity of the same stack - every point samples the cell that contains it; the difference in mm/yr on the map (diverging, centred at 0), the scatter with the 1:1 line, n, correlation, median difference (the two reference points) and MAD-std.

modules.title: SBAS preparation
modules.line: Network designer, derived pairs, batch unwrapping, closure maps.

steps.name: network
steps.caption: SBAS prep: design the network (temporal and perpendicular baseline limits plus sequential links) or import a CSV; the plot shows the selected pairs.
steps.command: bosar sbas network tour/indy_crop --stack crop_indy_downtown_ts --name ts --max-dt 36 --max-bperp 200 --k 3

steps.name: prep
steps.caption: One command derives every pair from the star stack, multilooks, estimates coherence, picks a common reference pixel, unwraps and checks triplet closure - resumable, in parallel workers.
steps.command: bosar sbas prep tour/indy_crop --network ts --looks 2,10 --backend snaphu --workers 6

steps.name: closure
steps.caption: Closure maps: RMS of the wrapped closure (phase bias) and the number of triplets that do not close (unwrapping errors).
steps.command: bosar sbas prep tour/indy_crop --network ts --looks 2,10 --backend snaphu --workers 6

modules.title: SBAS time series
modules.line: Velocity and temporal coherence; click a pixel for its displacement history.

steps.name: run
steps.caption: SBAS time series of a prepared network: closure-based unwrapping correction, pixel-wise inversion, tropospheric correction, geocoding.
steps.command: bosar pipeline sbas tour/indy_crop --network ts --tropo gacos

steps.name: velocity
steps.caption: LOS velocity in mm/yr (left, hidden where the temporal coherence is below 0.7) and the temporal coherence (right).
steps.command: bosar pipeline sbas tour/indy_crop --network ts --tropo gacos

steps.name: time_series
steps.caption: Click pixels: their LOS displacement history in mm with the linear fit and rate; toggle the corrections, export the curves as CSV.

steps.name: quality
steps.caption: Quality layers in radar geometry: the mask of pixels with a connected network and good temporal coherence, and the number of pairs each pixel used after the coherence, component and closure rules.
steps.command: bosar pipeline sbas tour/indy_crop --network ts --tropo gacos

modules.title: PS / DS time series
modules.line: Phase linking of distributed scatterers plus persistent scatterers: several times the coverage of multilooked SBAS, with a quality verdict.

steps.name: run
steps.caption: PS / DS time series: flattened SLC stack, statistically homogeneous pixels, phase linking (EMI), PS selection, then the SBAS unwrapping and inversion on the hybrid stack. A partially empty date is found and left out.

steps.name: linking
steps.caption: Phase linking in radar geometry: the temporal coherence of the fit (left; pure noise stays below 0.36 for this stack, a DS needs 0.6) and the number of statistically homogeneous pixels (right).

steps.name: types
steps.caption: Pixel type (0 none, 1 persistent scatterer, 2 distributed scatterer) and the amplitude dispersion that selects the PS.

steps.name: result
steps.caption: LOS velocity of the hybrid stack over the map with the persistent scatterers as points (colour = velocity, size = quality), the quality verdict above the map and the history of the clicked pixels.

modules.title: Classic PS-InSAR
modules.line: The periodogram chain (amplitude dispersion, arcs, APS) as a workflow of the Run page; its GeoPackage is a point layer of the Results page.

steps.name: run
steps.caption: Classic PS-InSAR as a workflow: persistent-scatterer candidates by amplitude dispersion, a Delaunay network, the periodogram on every arc (height error and rate at once), integration from a reference point, the atmospheric screen - an independent check of the PS / DS chain on the same flattened stack.

modules.title: SNAP bridge
modules.line: Preprocess raw Sentinel-1 zips with SNAP as the engine, import, process.

steps.name: form
steps.caption: Coregister with the engine set to snap: raw Sentinel-1 zips, sub-swath and an AOI that picks the bursts. SNAP's gpt runs as a separate program with Bosar's orbits and DEM; everything it writes stays in the project.
steps.command: bosar pipeline preprocess <project> --engine snap --product <S1 zip> … --subswath IW2 --aoi-wkt "POLYGON((…))"

steps.name: imported
steps.caption: The coregistered stack and its interferograms are imported as a BEAM-DIMAP stack; from here every workflow runs on it.

steps.name: result
steps.caption: DInSAR on the SNAP-preprocessed subset: unwrapped phase and coherence over the DEM box.

modules.title: SLC download
modules.line: Search Sentinel-1 scenes at ASF by the stack's track and frame or an AOI; a dry run, then a resumable, verified download that keeps running after the session.

steps.name: card
steps.caption: Sentinel-1 SLC scenes (ASF): the stack's relative orbit, frame and footprint pick the scenes of each date range; a dry run lists them with their sizes, the download resumes, verifies size and MD5, writes a provenance file per scene, stops below the free-space guard and keeps running after the session (`bosar fetch status`).

modules.title: Logs and failures
modules.line: Every run with its UTC-stamped records; a failure card says what, where and how.

steps.name: runs
steps.caption: Logs page: every run with its records - UTC timestamps, step, level, parameters, inputs, outputs, durations.

steps.name: failure
steps.caption: A failed step shows a card: the error code, what was wrong, where, and the hint for fixing it.

modules.title: Settings
modules.line: Theme, language, compute device, credentials, data roots.

steps.name: settings
steps.caption: Settings: theme (light, dark, system), language, compute device, storage mode, SNAPHU binary, basemap URL, data roots.

steps.name: credentials
steps.caption: A guided dialog per service: where to register, where to find the key, fill in or import from a file. Values go to the system keyring, never to a log.

modules.title: Native Sentinel-1
modules.line: From raw Sentinel-1 zips to a coregistered stack without SNAP - bursts, deramp, geometric coregistration, ESD, calibration, sub-swath merge - and a multi-year PS / DS time series on it.

steps.name: form
steps.caption: Coregister (Bosar): the native chain from raw zips - burst models from the annotation, precise orbits and the DEM for the offsets, deramp, sinc resampling, reramp, a range check, enhanced spectral diversity, deburst. Calibrated sigma nought and terrain-flattened gamma nought are written as extra layers; a re-run with more zips coregisters the new dates only.
steps.command: bosar pipeline s1-coregister <project> --product <S1 zip> … --subswath IW2 --aoi-wkt "POLYGON((…))" --calibration sigma0 --terrain-flatten

steps.name: merge
steps.caption: All three sub-swaths: each is coregistered, then merged onto one range / azimuth grid with the cut in the middle of each overlap; the seam check reports the phase and amplitude step across every cut.
steps.command: bosar pipeline s1-coregister <project> --product <S1 zip> … --subswath IW1,IW2,IW3 --tag full

steps.name: stack
steps.caption: The multi-year stack the native chain wrote (CINT16, ISCE layout), imported like any other: Sentinel-1A and Sentinel-1D dates on one reference grid.

steps.name: multi_year
steps.caption: Two years of downtown Indianapolis from the native stack (52 dates, Sentinel-1A and 1D): PS / DS velocity with the persistent scatterers as points and the displacement history of the clicked pixels. Nothing moves beyond the noise (1.4 mm/yr spread against 1.1 expected from the span); the red block west of the river is an unwrapping artefact across the coherence gap - the classic PSI chain does not show it.

modules.title: More sensors
modules.line: ALOS-1 PALSAR (L band), ENVISAT ASAR and ERS-1/2 through the stripmap chain: the stack with its sensor, the L-band quality profile, a Mexico City interferogram of each.

steps.name: stack
steps.caption: ALOS-1 PALSAR L1.1 (CEOS, straight from the ASF zips) through the stripmap chain - Doppler-aware geometric coregistration on the DEM, FBD oversampled onto the FBS range grid, calibration - and imported like any other stack: the sensor, the 23.6 cm wavelength and the baselines come with it. The same chain reads ENVISAT ASAR and ERS-1/2 (.N1 / .E1 / .E2 with DORIS orbits) and NISAR RSLC.
steps.command: bosar pipeline stripmap-coregister <project> --product <ALPSRP zip> … --reader alos --dem bosar --crop-wkt "POLYGON((…))" --id alos_pair

steps.name: profile
steps.caption: Next to the stack the Run page names the sensor, the band and the quality profile the verdict will use: at L band the coherence floors, the tolerated spread and the ionospheric model (filtered rather than a plane) are the L-band set - the same thresholds in radians, scaled by the wavelength. --iono adds the split-spectrum ionosphere of every pair.

steps.name: alos_pair
steps.caption: Mexico City, 20080214 - 20080331 (46 days, B⊥ −111 m): the unwrapped L-band phase of the pair in radar geometry. Positive phase is motion away from the sensor: Iztapalapa in the south-east subsides by about 4 rad = 7.5 cm of LOS in 46 days - the order of the published 20-40 cm/yr - with the ionosphere still in it (the split-spectrum model of this pair is a 1.1 rad range gradient).
steps.command: bosar sbas prep <project> --stack alos_pair --network pair --flat-step slc_flatten_alos_pair

steps.name: asar_pair
steps.caption: ENVISAT ASAR IS2, 20091225 - 20100305 (70 days), the same crop and route: the unwrapped C-band phase spans −12 … +10 rad, most of the basin 5 cm of LOS away from the north-west corner in 70 days - the Iztapalapa order of magnitude again, from a sensor that stopped in 2012. The ERS-1 / ERS-2 tandem day (1996) is in the same project: a turbulent ±6 rad atmosphere and nothing else.
steps.command: bosar pipeline stripmap-coregister <project> --product <ASA_IMS .N1> … --reader asar --dem bosar --crop-wkt "POLYGON((…))" --id asar_pair
